title: Combat FX master library
description: Full catalog of combat presentation presets (particles, camera, hit-stop, satisfiers). Reference for clients and designers; use sibling extensions to apply a single profile to a ruleset draft.
design_notes: Each preset maps to presentation.combat on the ruleset when applied via an apply-pack extension.
harm_entropy and tightness are tuned in apply packs to match visual intensity.
tbc-play / future renderers should read presentation.combat at runtime once the engine exposes it.
